Security policy

Source: SECURITY.md

Scope

bourse reads anonymous, public market-data endpoints only (Binance public REST: /api/v3/exchangeInfo, /api/v3/klines, /api/v3/depth, /api/v3/ticker/24hr). It does not require, accept, store, or transmit API keys, account credentials, or any private account data. The authenticated fee endpoint (/sapi/v1/asset/tradeFee) is deliberately not implemented: it would introduce a credential surface, and the fee_schedule fact is therefore reported as [unverified] rather than fetched.

If you are wiring bourse into a system that does hold exchange credentials, keep those credentials out of bourse’s call path entirely.

Reporting a vulnerability

If you discover a security issue – for example a path by which a credential could leak through a bourse code path, or a way the grounding machinery could be made to assert an ungrounded fact as grounded – please report it privately to the maintainer (see DESCRIPTION) rather than opening a public issue. Include a minimal reproduction and the affected version.

You can expect an acknowledgement within a reasonable window and a coordinated disclosure once a fix is available.

Recorded fixtures

The committed test fixtures under tests/testthat/fixtures/ are recorded-real public market-data responses. They contain no credentials, no account data, and no personal data, and each is hash-pinned in fixtures/PROVENANCE.md.
